newsitem.title: USA: Titan Wheel plans $100 million plant.
newsitem.headline: Titan Wheel plans $100 million plant.

text.p: Titan Wheel International Inc said Friday it plans to build a new $100 million agricultural, construction and specialty tire plant.
It said site selection for the new facility has been narrowed to Lake Charles, La. and Brownsville, Texas, with final selection anticipated within two weeks.
The newest Titan tire plant will employ between 500 and 700 workers once it reaches full operational capacity.
It will have the capability to produce radial as well as bias tires.

Titan currently operates two off-highway tire plants. In Des Moines, Iowa, it produces agricultural and construction tires, while in Clinton, Tenn., it makes smaller Titan and Dico branded recreation, trailer and grounds care tires.
